quotes.text: Failed and gave-up runs (Recommended): both leave the inbox once their change set is landed, withdrawn or rejected. Questions and sign-offs stay listed.
Yes, stale (Recommended): a failed or gave-up run on a superseded change set leaves the inbox, like one on a landed, withdrawn or rejected change set.

fields.summary: Planned with the owner on change set 01M62MKZFRPZ2C7QTYAF815XAG. A change set is stale when it has landed, been withdrawn, rejected or superseded. The owner picked: failed runs and runs the daemon gave up on leave the inbox once their change set is stale, questions and sign-offs stay listed, and superseded counts as stale. Still to build: rhiza run abandon takes a failed run, and the inbox names no next command that can only fail again. Nothing is open.
fields.title: Inbox clears stale failures, with the owner
